prompt: Create a clean fashion editorial campus poster featuring a young East Asian woman as two stylized versions of the same person in one studio composition. Use a vertical 4:5 canvas with a crisp white background and a solid deep red lower half like a graphic floor/backdrop. Place a small indoor soccer goal across the bottom foreground, with a black tubular frame and red netting, viewed straight on with slight depth. Put huge condensed bold blue sans-serif typography behind the subjects reading Next Move, split so “Next” fills the left background and “Move” fills the right background, partially hidden behind the figures. Show exactly 2 character figures: the main full-size figure sits on the top bar of the soccer goal at center-right, facing forward with long legs angled down to the right, one hand resting on a black-and-white soccer ball beside her and the other hand on the goal bar; the smaller figure sits at lower-left on the goal bar, wearing black rectangular glasses, holding exactly 2 thin pointer sticks or batons, with a slightly playful school-club attitude. Both figures wear matching all-black campus-uniform inspired outfits: short-sleeve collared shirt with buttoned chest pockets, black necktie, slim black belt, pleated skirt, black ankle socks, and glossy black loafers. The main figure has dark hair in a loose low updo with soft face-framing strands, pale natural skin, delicate makeup, and a calm confident expression. Use a red, white, and cobalt blue color palette with soccer elements, high-key studio lighting, sharp focus, polished magazine-poster retouching, playful but sophisticated composition, minimal shadows, no extra text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张风格简洁的校园时尚编辑海报，以 一位年轻东亚女性 为主角，在同一个摄影棚构图中呈现同一人物的两种风格化形象。使用 4:5 的竖向画布，背景为清爽的白色，下半部分为深红色的纯色块，如同图形化的地板或背景板。在底部前景放置一个小型的室内足球门，采用黑色管状框架和红色球网，正面视角并带有轻微的景深感。在主体后方使用巨大的蓝色压缩粗体无衬线排版，文字为 Next Move，将“Next”置于左侧背景，“Move”置于右侧背景，部分被人物遮挡。画面中展示 2 个角色：主人物为全尺寸，坐在足球门上方的横梁中央偏右位置，面向前方，双腿向右下方伸展，一只手放在身旁的黑白足球上，另一只手扶在球门横梁上；较小的人物坐在左下方横梁上，佩戴黑色长方形眼镜，手持 2 根细长的指示棒或指挥棒，展现出一种俏皮的校园社团风格。两个角色均穿着配套的纯黑色校园制服风格服装：短袖翻领衬衫配胸前口袋、黑色领带、黑色细腰带、百褶裙、黑色短袜及亮面黑色乐福鞋。主人物留着 深色低发髻，带有柔和的修饰脸型发丝，肤色白皙自然，妆容精致，表情沉稳自信。采用红、白、钴蓝配色方案，融入足球元素，使用高调摄影棚布光，焦点清晰，呈现杂志海报级的精修质感，构图俏皮而考究，阴影极少，无额外文字，无水印。
